coverage: Supplied RPC receipts and optional provider callTracer only. Transfer-shaped logs are emitted claims, not verified token balances or standard compliance. Reverted traces/attempts are not successful transfers; DELEGATECALL/CALLCODE values are excluded. Execution fees exclude blob, L1 data and operator fees. Discovery, when used, scans only direct from/to transactions in the recorded block range; token-only and internal-only address activity is not discovered. No complete history, net balances, exact fund attribution, ownership inference, or chain/finality proof.
